description.raw:
'''Active:''' '''Lee Sin''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] to the target allied unit's location. If the ally is a [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] upon arrival, both they and '''Lee Sin''' gain a [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shield]] for 2 seconds.
If the target is a [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minion]] or [[File:Ward_icon.png|20px|link=Ward|An icon representing the keyword Ward]] [[:Ward|ward]], '''Lee Sin''' also shields himself.
'''Lee Sin''' can [[self-targeted|self-cast]] ''Safeguard'' to shield himself.
description.text:
Active: Lee Sin dashes to the target allied unit's location. If the ally is a champion upon arrival, both they and Lee Sin gain a shield for 2 seconds.
If the target is a minion or ward, Lee Sin also shields himself.
Lee Sin can self-cast Safeguard to shield himself.

description2.raw: After ''Safeguard'' is cast, '''Lee Sin''' can cast ''[[File:Lee Sin Iron Will.png|20xpx|border|link=Lee Sin#Iron Will|An icon for Lee Sin's ability Iron Will]] [[Lee Sin#Iron Will|Iron Will]]'' within the next 3 seconds.
description2.text: After Safeguard is cast, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will within the next 3 seconds.

description3.raw: ''[[File:Lee Sin Iron Will.png|20xpx|border|link=Lee Sin#Iron Will|An icon for Lee Sin's ability Iron Will]] [[Lee Sin#Iron Will|Iron Will]] and [[File:Lee Sin Cripple.png|20xpx|border|link=Lee Sin#Cripple|An icon for Lee Sin's ability Cripple]] [[Lee Sin#Cripple|Cripple]] can be cast during the dash.''
description3.text: Iron Will and Cripple can be cast during the dash.

notes.text:
Lee Sin cannot self-cast Safeguard while grounded or rooted.
Safeguard can be used on any targetable allied unit excluding structures.
* This includes champions, minions, wards, and champion summoned units (e.g. Noxious Trap, Demacian Standard, Dark Passage).
If no unit is directly targeted, Safeguard will search for wards in a 100 radius to target.
* This aids Lee Sin in performing the dash to a ward he just placed.
Safeguard will not grant its shield if the dash is interrupted.
* If the dash overrides or is overridden by Resonating Strike, he will grant the shield immediately rather than on arrival.
If Safeguard's dash interrupts another dash, Tempest and Dragon's Rage can be cast during it (both otherwise cannot be cast).
